title: Testing the rank of the spot covariance matrix of a multidimensional Itô semi-martingale
summary: This work develops a statistical test for the maximal rank of the deterministic instantaneous (or spot) covariance matrix of a continuous-time $\mathbb{R}^d$-valued Itô semi-martingale $X(t)$ using high-frequency observations with a particular focus on the impact of an adapted drift. We explicitly account for the presence of an adapted drift process, which, as our results demonstrate, cannot be neglected, by introducing a re-centred covariance estimator instead of relying solely on a second moment estimator.
